Dota 2 Behavior Score and Overwatch penalties — repeated score drops with no meaningful explanation from Steam Support
1 hour ago
藍染 惣右介

I'm posting this because I'm genuinely fed up with how the Behavior Score and Overwatch systems are affecting my experience in Dota 2, and with the lack of meaningful answers I've received from Steam Support.


What I am asking for is a transparent, reliable process when a player believes an Overwatch decision may be incorrect.

## What happened?

I've been actively trying to improve my Behavior Score. I've avoided using chat and pings, muted other players, and focused on playing my games without unnecessary interactions.

My Behavior Score was steadily recovering, but then I received another Overwatch penalty.

Behavior & Comms Score 3.0: Definitive Overhaul Blueprint
22 Oct @ 3:52am
villum
Furthermore, zero telemetry anomalies guarantee a baseline behavior score increment, completely bypassing unverified user inputs

Section 3 (Fair Filtering & Automation Control): Implements deterministic logging and anti-bullying heuristics. If a user’s outgoing data streams register zero chat/audio activity, incoming "Communication Abuse" payloads are dropped instantly. Additionally, multi-reports from a single party are throttled and consolidated into a single instance (Weight = 1), while report-spam accounts have their feedback weight calibrated to zero

A well-designed moderation infrastructure must differentiate between a lack of skill & intentional malicious behavior.
